# Vendor Reference Tree

The `vendor/reference/` tree contains temporary copied source from upstream projects that informed the original STS concept.

It exists to help the Rust-first rewrite:

- inspect prior implementations locally
- port ideas into STS-owned crates
- compare interfaces while refactoring

It is **not** part of the active runtime dependency graph.

For provenance and copied source details, see [docs/VENDOR-REFERENCES.md](../docs/VENDOR-REFERENCES.md).
